key.name: takeover-osd
key.description: Show volume, brightness, and mute on the island instead of the stock OSD.

key.name: enable-low-battery
key.description: Show a compact pill when UPower reports a discharging low or critical warning. Does not replace the charging face.

key.name: show-seconds
key.summary: Show seconds on the idle clock

key.name: clock-format
key.description: One of follow, 12h, or 24h. follow uses the GNOME system setting.

key.name: system-timeout
key.summary: Charging, Bluetooth, and privacy hold time

key.name: compact-margin
key.summary: Compact pill inset from the panel edges
key.description: Pixels removed from the top and bottom of the compact island so it sits inside the top bar. Applies immediately.

key.name: vertical-offset
key.description: Move the island up (negative) or down (positive) relative to the panel. Applies immediately.

key.name: hide-panel-media-controls
key.description: Hide other MPRIS panel indicators (such as media-controls) so they do not sit behind the island. The GNOME date menu is never hidden.
